evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton issues a directive setting a recurring mandate and frames non-compliance as loss of capability — hierarchical command with consequence framing.
Records the cadence Quinton mandated, ratifying the directive's terms — reporting the authority-ranking act set in src-1.
Assigns ownership to the directive's author, ratifying the hierarchy by naming who holds authority over the rehearsals.
